title: UDGAMA
tagline: Empowering Future Engineers Through Innovation, Leadership and IEEE Excellence.
short_description: UDGAMA is the IEEE Guntur Subsection Student Congress, bringing together students, IEEE volunteers, researchers, academicians and industry professionals for technical learning, innovation, leadership development, competitions and professional networking.
long_description: UDGAMA is the annual flagship Student Congress of the IEEE Guntur Subsection, organized with the IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Activities Committee. Each edition brings engineering students together with IEEE leaders, researchers, academicians, and industry professionals for keynote and technical sessions, research poster presentations, innovation showcases, startup pitching, coding and ideation competitions, and professional networking.
